Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: activities, compound_structures, molecule_dictionary. Join: activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno and activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno. Filter: assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054503' and activities.standard_value is not null and activities.standard_relation = '='. Sort: canonical_smiles asc, chembl_id asc, standard_type asc, standard_relation asc, standard_value asc, standard_units asc.
